target_building.primary_use: Academic Classrooms, Computer Labs, Faculty Offices

interventions.name: Automated HVAC Scheduling & Unoccupied Temperature Setback
interventions.target_equipment: AHU-1, VAV Terminal Boxes, Chilled Water Pump Loop
interventions.implementation_details: Automated BMS schedule programmed with 21:00-06:00 night setback (cooling setpoint relaxed from 21.0°C to 27.5°C; heating setpoint lowered to 15.5°C). AHU variable frequency drive (VFD) supply fan speed clamped to 20% minimum ventilation rate during unoccupied hours. Local digital wall thermostat overrides restricted to maximum 90-minute auto-reset timer.

interventions.name: PIR Occupancy-Based Lighting Sweeps & Daylight Dimming
interventions.target_equipment: Atrium High-Bays, Common Area Corridors, Classroom Circuits
interventions.implementation_details: Commissioning of dual-technology Passive Infrared (PIR) and Ultrasonic vacancy sensors with 15-minute auto-off timeout across all lecture halls and classrooms. Automated DALI/0-10V controller sweeps all non-emergency lighting off at 20:30 daily. Daylight harvesting photo-sensors installed along South and East perimeter glazing zones to dynamically dim ambient fixtures by up to 60% during sunny hours.

interventions.name: Centralized Lab Workstation Power Policy & Smart Plug-Load Strip Shutdown
interventions.target_equipment: Computer Lab 202 Workstations, Maker Studio Peripherals, Faculty Office Electronics
interventions.implementation_details: Campus Active Directory Group Policy Object (GPO) deployed across all 40 engineering lab workstations enforcing S3 low-power sleep after 15 minutes of user inactivity. Installation of scheduled smart relay power distribution strips cutting 100% of phantom/vampire standby draw to peripheral electronics, soldering stations, and 3D printer heated beds between 20:00 and 07:00 daily.
